description: Airport Influence Area is a dataset listed in City of Salinas Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Salinas, Public Works Department, GIS Division. This is the Airport Overlay District (Zone AR) and the Airshow Boundary (Zone AB) from the Zoning Overlay Districts. Coverage: Salinas, California. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Airport, Airport Influence Area, Airshow. The portal shows 2 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityofsalinas-portal.
